methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 high-search ATX PSU models spanning 850 W-1000 W tiers from major brands (Corsair, Seasonic, be quiet!, EVGA, Thermaltake, MSI, Cooler Master, NZXT, ASUS, Super Flower). Primary sources are official manufacturer product pages and US store listings; corroboration drawn from Tom's Hardware, Hardware Busters, Guru3D, Newegg, Amazon, and KitGuru reviews and listings. Efficiency_rating reflects the 80 PLUS certification tier (gold/platinum); pcie_5_12vhpwr is true when any PCIe 5.0/5.1 native connector (12VHPWR or 12V-2x6) is included, false when absent; atx_version is the ATX spec the unit is currently certified or compliant with per its official product page (several ATX 3.0-launch units were re-certified to ATX 3.1). All prices are published US MSRP or typical list price in USD as a number. Adversarial re-verification 2026-06-19: corrected EVGA 1000 G7 price (259.99->239.99, confirmed MSRP); all other priceUsd/headline specs re-confirmed against primary sources; no fabricated products found. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Corsair RM850x (2024)
products.provenance: Corsair official page confirms 850 W, 80 PLUS Gold / Cybenetics Gold, fully modular, ATX 3.1, native 12V-2x6 connector, 140 mm FDB fan (NR140HP), 10-year warranty, $169.99 MSRP, 2024 model. Re-verified via TweakTown/Tom's Hardware/Hardware Busters/Amazon: $169.99 MSRP, 140 mm fan, ATX 3.1, 10-year warranty all corroborated. OEM is CWT.

products.name: Corsair RM1000e (2023)
products.provenance: Corsair official page (CP-9020264-NA, 2023 RMe series) re-verified 2026-06-19 and now states ATX 3.1 certified / PCIe 5.1 with 12V-2x6 cable, 1000 W, 80 PLUS Gold / Cybenetics Gold, fully modular, Zero RPM mode, 7-year warranty, $179.99 MSRP. Note: this unit launched in 2023 as ATX 3.0 / PCIe 5.0 (per KitGuru 2023 launch review) and was re-certified to ATX 3.1 (same hardware; 3.1 tightens 12V-2x6 connector definition); atx_version reflects current official certification. 120 mm Hong Hua rifle-bearing fan confirmed by Tom's Hardware.

products.name: Seasonic Focus GX-850 (V4)
products.provenance: Amazon listing (ASIN B0DLFMTX12) confirms 850 W, ATX 3.1, PCIe 5.1 (12V-2x6), fully modular, Cybenetics Platinum, 10-year warranty. Hardware Busters review and Seasonic launch coverage confirm 135 mm FDB fan and mid-November 2024 release. Black MSRP $149.99 USD corroborated (white version $159.99).

products.name: Seasonic Vertex GX-1000
products.provenance: Newegg and Amazon listings confirm 1000 W, 80 Plus Gold, ATX 3.0, fully modular, 16-pin 12VHPWR (PCIe 5.0), 135 mm FDB fan, 12-year warranty. Guru3D review and Seasonic launch corroborate 2023 availability (announced 2022) and $199.99 launch MSRP. Some retailer listings show 10-year; official Seasonic Vertex GX spec is 12-year.

products.name: be quiet! Pure Power 12 M 850W
products.provenance: be quiet! official product page confirms 850 W, 80 PLUS Gold (up to ~93% efficiency), fully modular, ATX 3.0, native 600W 12VHPWR connector, 120 mm fan, 10-year warranty. XDA Developers review corroborates ATX 3.0 / PCIe 5.0 support. Series announced Jan 24 2023, availability Feb 2023. MSRP $134.90 confirmed ($/EUR/GBP parity pricing). OEM HEC/Compucase.

products.name: EVGA SuperNOVA 1000 G7
products.provenance: EVGA official spec page for model 220-G7-1000-X1 confirms 1000 W, 80 PLUS Gold, fully modular, compact 130 mm chassis, 120 mm FDB fan, 10-year warranty, no PCIe 5.0/12VHPWR connector (pre-ATX-3.0 generation). Launched June 22 2022 (Tom's Hardware / Overclockers / theFPSreview). CORRECTED priceUsd 259.99->239.99: launch MSRP was $239.99 per Overclockers and Hardware Busters launch coverage.

products.name: Thermaltake Toughpower GF3 850W
products.provenance: Thermaltake USA official page confirms $129.99 MSRP, 850 W, 80 PLUS Gold, fully modular, ATX 3.1 (native 12+4-pin PCIe Gen5.1 / 12V-2x6 connector), 135 mm (13.5 cm) fluid-bearing fan, 10-year warranty. Tom's Hardware review confirms original ATX 3.0 launch (announced Sep 2022). Newegg lists current SKU as ATX 3.1; street price often ~$109.99 but $129.99 is the official MSRP per methodology.

products.name: MSI MPG A1000G PCIE5
products.provenance: Newegg listing confirms 1000 W, 80 PLUS Gold, fully modular, native 12V-2x6 cable, ATX 3.1 & PCIe 5.1 ready, 100% Japanese capacitors, 10-year warranty. MSI launched the A1000G PCIE5 in September 2022 at $199.99 MSRP (theFPSreview/TweakTown). 135 mm fan per MSI spec/reviews. Originally ATX 3.0; current SKU re-listed as ATX 3.1.

products.name: Cooler Master MWE Gold 850 V2
products.provenance: Cooler Master official page confirms 850 W, 80 PLUS Gold, fully modular (MPE-8501-AFAAG), ATX 12V v2.41, 120 mm HDB fan, semi-fanless mode, 5-year warranty. Amazon listing confirms no PCIe 5.0/12VHPWR connector (standard 6+2-pin PCIe only). MSRP ~$109.99. Released 2020.

products.name: NZXT C850 Gold (ATX 3.1)
products.provenance: NZXT official product page confirms 850 W, 80 PLUS Gold, fully modular, ATX 3.1, 12V-2x6 connector (up to 600 W), 135 mm FDB fan, Zero Fan Mode, 10-year warranty. $144.99 MSRP (current retail/Newegg list often $199.99 for the full kit). Amazon listing and 2024 coverage corroborate 2024 launch (white edition late Sep 2024).

products.name: ASUS ROG Strix 1000W Platinum
products.provenance: Amazon listing confirms 1000 W, 80 PLUS Platinum, fully modular, ATX 3.1, native 12V-2x6, Cybenetics Lambda A+, GaN MOSFET, 10-year warranty. Tom's Hardware and KitGuru reviews corroborate Platinum efficiency, ATX 3.1, PCIe 5 support, 135 mm fan, and November 2024 launch. $217.99 best-confirmed US retail price.

products.name: Super Flower Leadex VII XG 1000W
products.provenance: Newegg (black SF-1000F14XG) and Best Buy listings confirm 1000 W, 80 PLUS Gold, Cybenetics Platinum, fully modular, ATX 3.1 & PCIe 5.1, included 12VHPWR/12V-2x6 cable, 140 mm FDB fan. Pricing $159.99 confirmed across Newegg/Amazon/Best Buy. Warranty duration not verifiable from any retailer or Super Flower spec page consulted (reviewer commentary suggests 10-year but unconfirmed); set to null. A NULL BEATS A GUESS.
